summary: Stabilization Workstreams A (Master Timetable draft/validate/publish) and B (Employee<->User<->TeacherAssignment linking) tested end-to-end on a fresh school (slug test-stab-4fcddf); umv-hajipur was not touched. Backend: full pytest suite 240/240 PASS, including a new edge-case file (12 tests: grid fallback when no bell is default, break period rejected, teacher+room double-book across sections, lock blocks create/patch/delete, publish then edit reverts to draft, suggestions by name/email, link backfills employee_id on slots and assignments, user_already_linked, weak password, school_owner role rejected, case-insensitive email_in_use). Frontend (desktop 1920 + mobile 390): the grid shows 4 bell rows with no default bell, and the break row shows a 'Break' banner across the row. Cell editor works: teacher_double_book appears in cell-conflicts, then saving with a different teacher works. Validation panel works: tt-warning-teacher_not_assigned / empty_cells, and tt-error-teacher_inactive blocks publish and shows in the panel with the bad cell outlined in red. Publish gives 'published v1'. Editing after publish gives draft + tt-unpublished-badge. Lock disables Publish and cell editing. Bell change to an incompatible bell gives a 409 toast. Staff page: Login column, account-links-banner, and the review dialog link suggestion all work. Staff detail: create-login rejects a duplicate email with a clear toast, then creates and links. Linked view shows the assignment count. Unlink and relink work. Teacher Assignments: ta-unlinked-banner shows and then disappears once everyone is linked; ta-teacher-select shows 'Name · EMP-code'. After a TA is created, the cell teacher picker lists 'Assigned to this subject' teachers first and auto-fills the teacher. Mobile: the grid scrolls sideways inside its container (scrollWidth 361 > clientWidth 340) and the page body does not overflow.

minor.issue: _resolve_bell calls _oid() on the requested id, so a malformed bell_schedule_id returns 404 'Not found' for the whole grid instead of being ignored and falling back to default/first bell.

A malformed user_id returns 404 (from _oid), while a valid-but-unknown id returns 400 'user_id not found'. Inconsistent. Linking also accepts any role (e.g. school_owner or parent users) without checking.

The slot is validated against the payload's bell_schedule_id, not the section meta's bell. A caller can place a slot that fits another bell but lands on a break in the section's bell. Publish-time validation does catch it (period_is_break).
Re-publishing with no changes still increments version (v1 -> v2) and writes an audit entry.

When HTTPException.detail is a dict, the envelope's error.message is the generic 'Request failed'; the real message sits only in error.details.message (handled on the frontend now, see updated_files).

ui_bugs.issue: Structured 409s (bell_incompatible, validation_failed, timetable_locked, etc.) showed the toast 'Request failed' because formatApiError read error.message rather than error.details.message. FIXED in lib/api.js; bell_incompatible now shows "Existing slots don't fit this bell schedule: mon P1" and email_in_use shows its full message.

When a slot's teacher login is disabled, the cell shows only the subject and no teacher name, because the lookups come from /timetable/teachers, which returns active teachers only. The teacher_inactive error then points at a cell with no visible teacher.

On a section that has never been edited (meta=null), Validate, Publish and Lock are all disabled, but the badge says 'draft'. The user cannot run Validate to see empty_timetable until they open a cell.

issues: The 'capitalize' class renders 'Teacher Assignment(S)' with a capital S. Use 'assignment(s)' outside the capitalize span.
Room SelectItems have no data-testid (subject and teacher options do).

action_items: (Low) Show disabled or inactive teacher names in grid cells, e.g. include inactive teachers in the lookup or return a teacher name with each slot in /timetable/grid.
(Low) Enable Validate on sections with no meta, or create the meta lazily on validate.
(Low) In _resolve_bell, ignore a malformed requested bell_schedule_id instead of returning 404.
(Low) Make the link endpoint's errors consistent (400 for malformed user_id). Consider restricting linkable roles.
(Low) Optionally skip the version bump when publishing with has_unpublished_changes=false.
(Cosmetic) Fix the 'Assignment(S)' capitalisation and add data-testid to room options.
critical_code_review_comments: The global exception handler drops dict-detail messages into error.details.message and sets error.message='Request failed'. The frontend now handles this. A cleaner backend fix is to copy detail.message into error.message.

There is no unique index enforcing the 1:1 employees.user_id link. link_employee_user does check-then-update, so two concurrent links could both succeed. Consider a partial unique index on (tenant_id, user_id) where user_id != null.
timetable_routes.py is 1310 lines. Split proxy/substitution routes into their own module (guideline: >700 lines).
_validate_section runs one find_one per slot for teacher and room double-book checks (N+1). Fine for one section, but batch it if sections grow.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; 1 medium toast bug fixed; 2 low UI issues reported

Pytest also creates throwaway sta-/stb-/test-stab- schools.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login wait: do NOT use wait_for_url('**/school**') because the host 'schoolos-foundation' matches. Use the regex r'.*\.com/school.*'. Timetable picker option testids are '{picker}-opt-{id}'. TA dialog: ta-teacher-select options 'tat-{uid}', class 'tacls-{id}', section 'tas-{id}', and the Create button is found by role. Workstreams C and D (admissions) are not built and were not tested.
rca of the issue: Toast 'Request failed' on structured 409s: the backend error envelope is {error:{code:'conflict', message:'Request failed', details:{code, message}}} whenever HTTPException.detail is a dict. formatApiError read error.message first, and that string is always the generic text, so the real reason was hidden. Reproduced by picking an incompatible bell on the grid. Fix: formatApiError checks error.details.message first. Verified the toast now shows the specific message.
